data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross reserve release of GBP 2.661 million for prior accident years, representing a 1.06% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This movement was a result of mixed development across various underwriting years, with some years showing strengthening and others releases, as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. The managing agent's report also noted a net favourable development of GBP 2.3m on prior accident year losses. Key sources of estimation uncertainty include claims provisions and related recoveries. During the year, the syndicate incurred notable losses from Hurricane Matthew, the Fort McMurray Wildfire, and the Belgium terror attacks.
